title: The first hashtag anyone proposed on Twitter.
description:
The first hashtag anyone proposed on Twitter.

a product consultant, posted the idea to Twitter on 23 August, asking how people felt about using the pound sign for groups.

Internet Relay Chat had used the pound sign to label channels since around 1988. Messina adapted an existing convention rather than starting from nothing.

Twitter did not adopt the idea. Its own users did, that October, tagging posts about the San Diego wildfires so people could follow the story. Twitter itself only began turning hashtags into clickable links on 2 July 2009, almost two years after the original tweet.

Messina never tried to patent it. He said hashtags were born of the internet, and owned by no one.
